'''Bio droid''' was a term used to describe [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who could link their [[nervous system]] to their [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Computer/Legends|computer system]]. After making the connection, bio droids would fly as if their body and the ship were a single entity.
